observations: Two photos show a large cylindrical green plastic water tank, ribbed/corrugated sides, standing outdoors on bare ground.
A raised square section at the top (photo 1) appears to be a lid or inlet cover.
A faint triangular logo mark and the text 'GEEPEE' are embossed on the tank body, visible in both photos though partly obscured by the watermark.
Tank surface shows dirt/staining consistent with outdoor use; no visible cracks or deformation in the photos.
No capacity marking (liters) is visible in either photo.
Base, outlet valve, and underside of the tank are not shown in either photo.
Background shows a building with window grilles/burglar bars and bare earth yard, consistent with an Abuja compound setting.

claims.claim: Fairly used green GEEPEE water storage tank
claims.evidence: Brand name visible in photo 0 and photo 1; 'fairly used' condition cannot be confirmed structurally from exterior photos alone.
Claim is incomplete in the seller's text; no content to verify against photos.

risks.risk: Tank capacity (liters) unknown, which is the main price driver for water tanks.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the capacity/size label usually printed or embossed near the top or side of GEEPEE tanks, or a tape measure against height and diameter.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at any tier without this; treated as unknown specification

risks.risk: Cracks, punctures, or repairs on the base or underside, common in used tanks moved from storage.
risks.proof: Photo of the tank tipped on its side or underside, and close-up of the base rim.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if base integrity unconfirmed, i.e. at risk of leakage

risks.risk: Condition of inlet/outlet valve and lid, which affect usability and installation cost.
risks.proof: Close-up of the lid area and any outlet/tap fitting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if fittings missing or needing replacement

risks.risk: UV brittleness from prolonged outdoor sun exposure, which can shorten tank lifespan.
risks.proof: Information on age/years in use, or photo showing any fading/chalking texture on the plastic surface.
risks.if_unproven: priced as moderately aged with reduced remaining lifespan

proof_requests: Clear photo of the capacity/liter marking on the tank body.
Photo of the tank base, underside, and outlet valve.
Photo of the lid/inlet area fully open and closed.
Any information on the age of the tank or reason for sale.
response.reason: The brand is identifiable as GEEPEE but the capacity, which sets the price tier for water tanks, is not visible in either photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be assigned without it.
